f1808e1b9644d90a3921eebd5adaa263c762b214.sql:
SELECT
    t3.acctident AS account_id,
    t2.netinflscore AS overall_reach_score,
    t1.postfreq AS posting_frequency,
    t2.clustsize AS cluster_member_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.netinflscore DESC) AS influence_rank
FROM
    contentbehavior AS t1
JOIN
    moderationaction AS t2 ON t1.cntref = t2.macntref
JOIN
    account AS t3 ON t2.macntref = t3.accindex
WHERE
    t2.clustrole = 'Amplifier'
    AND t2.coordscore > 0.8
    AND t1.postfreq > 0
ORDER BY
    t2.netinflscore DESC
LIMIT 10;

ea678240044e1cdc9714c25026b7eb46fbf0e470.sql:
SELECT 
    a.accindex AS account_id,
    (s.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'riskval')::NUMERIC AS bot_behavior_index,
    s.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'threatlvl' AS risk_tier
FROM 
    account AS a
JOIN 
    securitydetection AS s
        ON a.accindex = s.sectechref
WHERE 
    a.acctstatus = 'Dormant'
    AND a.acctcategory = 'Bot'
    AND (s.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'riskval')::NUMERIC > 0.8
    AND s.detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'threatlvl' = 'Critical'
LIMIT 10;

03302baafed705b5e50a13df0b107255928c8b46.sql:
SELECT 
    a.accindex AS account_id,
    a.acctstatus AS account_status,
    ds.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS autobehavscore,
    ds.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' AS botlikscore
FROM 
    account AS a
JOIN 
    securitydetection AS ds ON a.accindex = ds.sectechref
WHERE 
    a.acctstatus IN ('Dormant', 'Deleted')
    AND a.acctcategory = 'Bot'
GROUP BY 
    a.accindex, a.acctstatus, ds.detection_score_profile
ORDER BY 
    autobehavscore DESC, botlikscore DESC;

    sessionbehavior AS sb ON nm.netsessref = sb.sessref

    account AS a ON sb.sessprofref = a.accindex

    m.authenscore ASC

    MAX(ma.coordscore) AS top_coordination_score,
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT a.acctident) AS account_list
FROM 
    moderationaction ma
JOIN 
    securitydetection sd ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey

    account a ON a.accindex = sd.sectechref

    ma.clustsize
ORDER BY 
    cluster_size DESC;

024c7ef39928989f46238256daed6d508869a68c.sql:
SELECT 
    platident AS platform_id,
    detecttime AS time,
    clustsize AS total_member_count,
    MAX(coordscore) AS top_coordination_score,
    ARRAY_AGG(acctident) AS account_list
FROM 
    moderationaction AS ma
JOIN 
    account AS a ON ma.modactkey = a.accindex
JOIN 
    securitydetection AS s ON ma.masedetref = s.secdetkey
WHERE 
    clustsize > 1 
GROUP BY 
    platident, detecttime, clustsize
ORDER BY 
    platident;

9f7c5190341f2c438758dc89308c7896d0afc045.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.accindex AS account_id,
    t2.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS bot_behavior_index,
    CASE 
        WHEN CAST(t2.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS NUMERIC) > 0.8 THEN 'High'
        WHEN CAST(t2.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS NUMERIC) > 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS risk_tier
FROM 
    account AS t1
JOIN 
    securitydetection AS t2 ON t1.accindex = t2.sectechref
WHERE 
    t1.acctstatus = 'Dormant' 
    AND t1.acctcategory = 'Bot'
    AND CAST(t2.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'autobehavscore' AS NUMERIC) > 0.2
ORDER BY 
    risk_tier DESC;

3e82405013548ce6a52cc719a2de3d874cb6d80c.sql:
SELECT 
    t2.acctident AS account_id,
    t1.detection_score_profile->'overall' AS overall_weirdness_score,
    t1.detection_score_profile->'behavior_scores'->>'botlikscore' AS recent_bot_rating
FROM 
    securitydetection AS t1
JOIN 
    account AS t2 ON t1.sectechref = t2.accindex
WHERE 
    t2.acctcategory = 'Bot'
ORDER BY 
    recent_bot_rating DESC
LIMIT 10;

3c1a976006f87ae7c8ca1c59c8b2debdae28f5f0.sql:
WITH content_farms AS (
    SELECT 
        cb.cntref AS content_reference_id,
        cb.cntsimscore AS content_manipulation_score,
        cb.postfreq AS frequency_related_details,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cb.cntsimscore DESC) AS manipulation_rank
    FROM 
        contentbehavior cb
    WHERE 
        cb.cntsimscore > 0.7
        AND cb.postfreq > 50
)
SELECT 
    content_reference_id,
    content_manipulation_score,
    frequency_related_details,
    manipulation_rank
FROM 
    content_farms
ORDER BY 
    manipulation_rank;

9212405ac93684cbfc10bb333dc8a35a0db5cf2a.sql:
WITH potential_amplification_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        ma.modactkey,
        ma.clustsize AS total_member_count,
        ma.coordscore AS top_coordination_score,
        array_agg(DISTINCT a.accindex) AS account_list
    FROM 
        moderationaction AS ma
    JOIN 
        securitydetection AS sd ON ma.masedetref = sd.secdetkey
    JOIN 
        account AS a ON a.accindex = sd.sectechref -- Assuming sectechref references the account
    WHERE 
        ma.clustsize > 1 
    GROUP BY 
        ma.modactkey, ma.clustsize, ma.coordscore, sd.detecttime
),
platform_grouped AS (
    SELECT 
        a.plattype, 
        a.platident AS platform_id,
        sd.detecttime AS time,
        paa.total_member_count, 
        paa.top_coordination_score,
        paa.account_list
    FROM 
        potential_amplification_activity AS paa
    JOIN 
        securitydetection AS sd ON paa.modactkey = sd.secdetkey
    JOIN 
        account AS a ON a.accindex = sd.sectechref
)
SELECT 
    *
FROM 
    platform_grouped;

WITH ranked_accounts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex AS account_id,
        ma.authenscore AS engagement_authenticity_score,
        sb.acttimedist->>'timing_pattern' AS timing_pattern,
        'Manipulator' AS status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ma.authenscore DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        account a
    JOIN 
        profile p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    JOIN 
        sessionbehavior sb ON p.profkey = sb.sessprofref
    JOIN 
        moderationaction ma ON a.accindex = ma.macntref
)
SELECT 
    account_id, 
    engagement_authenticity_score,
    timing_pattern,
    status
FROM 
    ranked_accounts
LIMIT 10;

e0f03d9861e46de2747842d0953ca5b2b4f62622.sql:
WITH security_risk_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        secdetkey,
        (
            (detection_score_profile->'overall'->>'riskval')::FLOAT * 
            (1 + 0.2 * ti.ipcountrynum)
        ) AS cross_risk_score
    FROM securitydetection
    INNER JOIN technicalinfo AS ti ON securitydetection.sectechref = ti.techkey
),
session_tallies AS (
    SELECT 
        sessprofref,
        SUM(sesscount) AS session_tally
    FROM sessionbehavior
    GROUP BY sessprofref
),
posting_speeds AS (
    SELECT 
        cntsessref,
        AVG(postfreq) AS overall_posting_speed
    FROM contentbehavior
    GROUP BY cntsessref
),
account_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        a.accindex,
        COALESCE(st.session_tally, 0) AS session_tally,
        COALESCE(ps.overall_posting_speed, 0) AS overall_posting_speed,
        1 AS fixed_platform_count,
        COALESCE(srs.cross_risk_score, 0) AS cross_risk_score
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN profile AS p ON a.accindex = p.profaccref
    LEFT JOIN session_tallies AS st ON p.profkey = st.sessprofref
    LEFT JOIN posting_speeds AS ps ON p.profkey = ps.cntsessref
    LEFT JOIN security_risk_scores AS srs ON p.profkey = srs.secdetkey
)
SELECT 
    accindex,
    session_tally,
    overall_posting_speed,
    fixed_platform_count,
    cross_risk_score
FROM account_metrics
ORDER BY session_tally DESC
LIMIT 1;
